args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Treat unescaped double quotes occurring in the middle of unquoted fields (such as inch marks like 27") as ordinary characters rather than starting an unclosed quoted field, so rows with quotation marks parse successfully.
args.title: Handle unescaped quotes in unquoted CSV fields
